what_happened: Re-derived run-all.sh counts independently per dispatch instruction: BimodalLogic (the repro env for the external-source-store cause) now shows 37 of 174 suites failing (2 EXPECTED baseline, 35 NEW), not the originally-cited 26 of 156. Of the 35 NEW, only 6 of the originally-named 8 suites (test-askuserquestion-rehome.sh, test-deploy-propagation.sh, test-routing-resolution.sh, test-update-task-status.sh, test-lint-dead-command-recommendations.sh, test-manifest-scripts-sync.sh) are actually caused by the external-source-store condition -- confirmed by a hardcoded agent-system/extensions/* path with no .claude-extensions.json or deployed-tree fallback in each. The other 2 named suites (test-gate-cache-lib.sh, test-orchestrate-build-aux-dispatch.sh) fail identically in nvim too, which HAS a local agent-system/ -- so their failure is NOT the external-source-store cause; they are misattributed. The remaining ~29 NEW failures in BimodalLogic (10 of which also fail identically in nvim) form a separate, large, currently-live regression cluster around deploy/gate/orchestrate-postflight machinery, unrelated to source-store topology and out of this task's scope.
